title: Add CLI chronicle inspection and curation
description: Expose character chronicle records through CLI commands so players can inspect portable memories and mark records as portable/private/archived before carrying a character onward.
acceptance_criteria: CLI can list chronicle records for a registry character and update portability/visibility/archive status; commands are explicit and do not mutate campaign canon; tests cover list and curation flows.
notes:
Implemented: registry-level 'eshyra chronicle' subcommand (list/show/set/archive) in packages/cli/src/chronicle.ts, wired in index.ts, tested in packages/cli/test/chronicle.test.ts. PR #350 open (branch eshyra-lupf-16-1-chronicle-cli). verify:worktree green (2819 passed). Close when #350 merges, then close the lupf.16 epic.
PR #350 review addressed (commit 95ec777): registry-membership check added to show/set/archive (was list-only); dm-only records spoiler-hidden by default in list/show with --include-dm-only to reveal, and dm-only text redacted in curation confirmations. Tests 10 -> 17, verify:worktree green (2826 passed).
Landed on main: PR #350 merged (merge commit e32baaa, reachable from main HEAD). chronicle.ts + chronicle.test.ts present. Branch and worktree cleaned up. Closing.
